name: Modules.Map
description:
### Requirements

-   Google Maps API key (required for both development and production)
-   Google Play services SDK installed using the Android SDK manager
-   This module only works on Android devices.  This module is not supported on the Android emulator

### Getting Started

-   Edit the `modules` section of your tiapp.xml file to include this module:

    ``` xml
    <ti:app>
        [modules](api:Modules)
            <!-- Add this line to your modules section -->
            <module platform="android">ti.map</module>
        </modules>
    </ti:app>
    ```

-   Obtain a Google Maps API key.  For instructions, refer to the "Obtain and Add a Google API Key"
    section in the
    [Google Maps v2 for Android guide](http://docs.appcelerator.com/titanium/latest/#!/guide/Google_Maps_v2_for_Android).

-   Add the following `meta-tag` element to the Android manifest section of the tiapp.xml
    file. You may need to add the `manifest` and `application` elements.
    ``` xml
    <ti:app>
        <android xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
            <manifest>
                <application>
                    <!-- Replace "YOUR_API_KEY" with the Google API key you obtained -->
                    <meta-data 
                        android:name="com.google.android.geo.API_KEY"
                        android:value="YOUR_API_KEY" />
                </application>
            </manifest>
        </android>
    </ti:app>
    ```

-   Instantiate the module with the `import Map from 'ti.map'` API, then make subsequent API calls with
    the new map object.

    ``` javascript
    import Map from 'ti.map';

    const mapView = Map.createView({
      mapType: Map.NORMAL_TYPE
    });
    ```

## iOS

This module is a replacement for the built-in Titanium.Map module on iOS.

For more instructions and examples of using the module, refer to the
[iOS Map Kit guide](http://docs.appcelerator.com/titanium/latest/#!/guide/iOS_Map_Kit).

### Requirements

-   Applications using this module must be built using Xcode 5 or later.

### Getting Started

-   Edit the `modules` section of your tiapp.xml file to include this module:

    ``` xml
    <ti:app>
        [modules](api:Modules)
            <!-- Add this line to your modules section -->
            <module platform="iphone">ti.map</module>
        </modules>
    </ti:app>
    ```

-   To use the `userLocation` property in iOS 8 and later, add either the
    [`NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription`](https://developer.apple.com/library/prerelease/ios/documentation/General/Reference/InfoPlistKeyReference/Articles/CocoaKeys.html#//apple_ref/doc/uid/TP40009251-SW26)
    or
    [`NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription`](https://developer.apple.com/library/prerelease/ios/documentation/General/Reference/InfoPlistKeyReference/Articles/CocoaKeys.html#//apple_ref/doc/uid/TP40009251-SW18)
    key to the iOS plist section of the project's `tiapp.xml` file.

    ``` xml
    <ti:app>
        <ios>
            <plist>
                <dict>
                    <key>NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription</key>
                    [string](api:Global.String)
                        Specify the reason for accessing the user's location information.
                        This appears in the alert dialog when asking the user for permission to
                        access their location.
                    </string>
                </dict>
            </plist>
        </ios>
    </ti:app>
    ```

-   Instantiate the module with the `import Map from 'ti.map'` API, then make subsequent API calls with
    the new map object.

    ``` javascript
    import Map from 'ti.map';

    const mapView = Map.createView({
      mapType: Map.NORMAL_TYPE
    });
    ```

### Breaking Changes

-   The `addRoute` method no longer accepts a dictionary as a parameter. Pass a [Modules.Map.Route](api:Modules.Map.Route) object instead.

examples.title: Basic Map Example
Alloy XML Markup
examples.code:
Previous example as an Alloy view.

In XML markup, use the `View` element with the `module` attribute set to `ti.map` to create an
instance of a map view, then use the `Annotation` element to define an annotation.

In the initializer file, load the map module and assign it to the `Alloy.Globals.Map` namespace.
This variable can be used to reference map module constants in the project, as seen in the TSS
file to assign the `pincolor` attribute.

`alloy.js`:

``` javascript
// Loads the map module to the global Alloy scope, which can be referenced by Alloy.Globals.Map
Alloy.Globals.Map = require('ti.map');
```

`app/views/index.xml`:

``` xml
<Alloy>
    <Window>
        <Module id="mapView" module="ti.map" onClick="report" method="createView">
            <Annotation id="appcHQ" myId="1337" />
        </Module>
    </Window>
</Alloy>
```

`app/styles/index.tss`:

``` javascript
"#mapView": {
    region: {
        latitude: 33.74511,
        longitude: -84.38993,
        latitudeDelta: 0.01,
        longitudeDelta: 0.01
    }
},
"#appcHQ": {
    latitude: 37.368122,
    longitude: -121.913653,
    title: "Appcelerator Headquarters",
    subtitle: "San Jose, CA",
    pincolor: Alloy.Globals.Map.ANNOTATION_RED
}
```

`app/controllers/index.js`:

``` javascript
function report(event) {
    Ti.API.info('Annotation ' + event.title + ' clicked, ID: ' + event.annotation.myID);
}

$.index.open();
```

properties.name: FEATURE_DISPLAY_PRIORITY_DEFAULT_HIGH
properties.summary: Constant indicating that the item's display priority is high.
properties.description:
An annotation view with this priority is removed from the map when its bounds
collide with the bounds of another view with a higher priority. If the priorities
of the two views are equal, the view furthest from the center of the map's visible
region is hidden first.

properties.name: FEATURE_DISPLAY_PRIORITY_DEFAULT_LOW
properties.summary: Constant indicating that the item's display priority is low.
properties.description:
An annotation view with this priority is removed from the map when its bounds
collide with the bounds of another view with a higher priority. If the priorities
of the two views are equal, the view furthest from the center of the map's visible
region is hidden first.

properties.name: FEATURE_DISPLAY_PRIORITY_REQUIRED
properties.summary: Constant indicating that the item is required.
properties.description: An annotation view with this priority does not participate in clustering.

properties.name: FEATURE_PHYSICAL_FEATURES
properties.summary:
The option that represents physical map features such as mountain ranges, rivers,
and ocean basins.

properties.name: FEATURE_TERRITORIES
properties.summary:
The option that represents territorial boundaries such as a national border,
a state boundary, or a neighborhood.

properties.name: FEATURE_TYPE_POINT_OF_INTEREST
properties.summary: The option that represents points of interest such as museums, cafes, parks, or schools.

properties.name: FEATURE_VISIBILITY_ADAPTIVE
properties.summary: Constant indicating that title text adapts to the current map state.
properties.description:
For markers in the normal state, title text is displayed and subtitle text is hidden. When a marker
is selected, the title and subtitle text are hidden when the marker requires a callout.

properties.name: FEATURE_VISIBILITY_HIDDEN
properties.summary: Constant indicating that title text is always hidden.

properties.name: FEATURE_VISIBILITY_VISIBLE
properties.summary: Constant indicating that title text is always visible.

properties.name: HYBRID_FLYOVER_TYPE
properties.summary: Used with [mapType](api:Modules.Map.View#mapType) to display a satellite flyover image of the area with road and road name information layered on top. Available in iOS 9.0 and later.

properties.name: HYBRID_TYPE
properties.summary: Used with [mapType](api:Modules.Map.View#mapType) to display a satellite image of the area with road and road name information layered on top.

properties.name: MUTED_STANDARD_TYPE
properties.summary:
Used with [mapType](api:Modules.Map.View#mapType) to display a street map where your data is emphasized over
the underlying map details. Available in iOS 11.0 and later. On Android it is mapped to `NORMAL_TYPE`.

properties.name: NORMAL_TYPE
properties.summary: Used with [mapType](api:Modules.Map.View#mapType) to display a street map that shows the position of all roads and some road names.

properties.name: OVERLAY_LEVEL_ABOVE_LABELS
properties.summary: Place the overlay above roadways but below map labels, shields, or point-of-interest icons. Available in iOS 7.0 and later.

properties.name: OVERLAY_LEVEL_ABOVE_ROADS
properties.summary:
Place the overlay above map labels, shields, or point-of-interest icons but below annotations and 3D projections of buildings.
Available in iOS 7.0 and later.

properties.name: POLYLINE_JOINT_BEVEL
properties.summary: Flat bevel on the outside of the joint.

properties.name: POLYLINE_JOINT_DEFAULT
properties.summary: Default: Mitered joint, with fixed pointed extrusion equal to half the stroke width on the outside of the joint.

properties.name: POLYLINE_JOINT_ROUND
properties.summary: Rounded on the outside of the joint by an arc of radius equal to half the stroke width, centered at the vertex.

properties.name: POLYLINE_PATTERN_DASHED
properties.summary: Polyline type constant used to display a dashed polyline via [Modules.Map.Polyline.pattern](api:Modules.Map.Polyline#pattern) property.

properties.name: POLYLINE_PATTERN_DOTTED
properties.summary: Polyline type constant used to display a dotted polyline via [Modules.Map.Polyline.pattern](api:Modules.Map.Polyline#pattern) property.

properties.name: REASON_API_ANIMATION
properties.summary: Used in the [regionwillchange](api:Modules.Map.View#regionwillchange) event. The animation was initiated in response to the user actions.

properties.name: REASON_DEVELOPER_ANIMATION
properties.summary: Used in the [regionwillchange](api:Modules.Map.View#regionwillchange) event. The camera moved in response to a request from the application.

properties.name: REASON_GESTURE
properties.summary: Used in the [regionwillchange](api:Modules.Map.View#regionwillchange) event. The camera moved in response to the user gestures on the map.

properties.name: SATELLITE_FLYOVER_TYPE
properties.summary: Used with [mapType](api:Modules.Map.View#mapType) to display satellite flyover imagery of the area. Available in iOS 9.0 and later.

properties.name: SATELLITE_TYPE
properties.summary: Used with [mapType](api:Modules.Map.View#mapType) to display satellite imagery of the area.

properties.name: SEARCH_RESULT_TYPE_ADDRESS
properties.summary: A value that indicates that search results include addresses.

properties.name: SEARCH_RESULT_TYPE_POINT_OF_INTEREST
properties.summary: A value that indicates that search results include points of interest.

properties.name: SEARCH_RESULT_TYPE_QUERY
properties.summary: A value that indicates that the search completer includes query completions in results.

properties.name: SERVICE_DISABLED
properties.summary: Code returned from [Modules.Map.isGooglePlayServicesAvailable](api:Modules.Map#isGooglePlayServicesAvailable). Google Play services has been disabled on this device.

properties.name: SERVICE_INVALID
properties.summary: Code returned from [Modules.Map.isGooglePlayServicesAvailable](api:Modules.Map#isGooglePlayServicesAvailable). The version of Google Play services installed on this device is not authentic.

properties.name: SERVICE_MISSING
properties.summary: Code returned from [Modules.Map.isGooglePlayServicesAvailable](api:Modules.Map#isGooglePlayServicesAvailable). Google Play services is not installed on the device.

properties.name: SERVICE_VERSION_UPDATE_REQUIRED
properties.summary: Code returned from [Modules.Map.isGooglePlayServicesAvailable](api:Modules.Map#isGooglePlayServicesAvailable). Google Play services is out of date.

properties.name: SUCCESS
properties.summary: Code returned from [Modules.Map.isGooglePlayServicesAvailable](api:Modules.Map#isGooglePlayServicesAvailable). Google Play services is available, and the connection is successful.

methods.name: geocodeAddress
methods.summary:
Resolve address details using the `CLGeocoder` to get information (e.g.
latitude, longitude, postal code and city) about a given input address.
methods.description: The result is provided via the callback (second function argument).

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary:
Function to be called upon completion (either success with a place
or an error).

methods.name: getLookAroundImage
methods.summary: A utility function that you use to create a static image from a LookAround scene.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: Function to be called upon completion (either success with an image or an error).

methods.name: isGooglePlayServicesAvailable
methods.summary: Returns a code to indicate whether Google Play Services is available on the device.

returns.summary:
One of the following status codes:
[Modules.Map.SUCCESS](api:Modules.Map#SUCCESS), [Modules.Map.SERVICE_MISSING](api:Modules.Map#SERVICE_MISSING),
[Modules.Map.SERVICE_VERSION_UPDATE_REQUIRED](api:Modules.Map#SERVICE_VERSION_UPDATE_REQUIRED),
[Modules.Map.SERVICE_DISABLED](api:Modules.Map#SERVICE_DISABLED) or [Modules.Map.SERVICE_INVALID](api:Modules.Map#SERVICE_INVALID).

methods.name: search
methods.summary:
Uses the native `MKLocalSearchCompleter` class to search places for
a given input value.
methods.description:
Please use the `didUpdateResults` event to get updates for a search
completion request via the `results` field. If the search failed, the
`results` field is empty and an `error` is provided.

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary: Additional options to fine-tune the search request.

inlined.name: SearchCompletionOptions
inlined.summary: Additional options to fine-tune the search request.
inlined.description: The latitude and longitude describe the location, the delta values the distance to include.

properties.name: region
properties.summary:
The region to look for results. Note that only `latitude`, `longitude`, `latitudeDelta` and `longitudeDelta`
are currently handled to define the region.

properties.name: resultTypes
properties.summary: These options configure the types of search results you want to receive, including points of interest and addresses.
properties.description:
Use one or more of the following constants:
  - [Modules.Map.SEARCH_RESULT_TYPE_ADDRESS](api:Modules.Map#SEARCH_RESULT_TYPE_ADDRESS)
  - [Modules.Map.SEARCH_RESULT_TYPE_POINT_OF_INTEREST](api:Modules.Map#SEARCH_RESULT_TYPE_POINT_OF_INTEREST)
  - [Modules.Map.SEARCH_RESULT_TYPE_QUERY](api:Modules.Map#SEARCH_RESULT_TYPE_QUERY)
